verdict.rationale: GrowthBook gives indirect control over data residency, and therefore retention. It can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure with your own MongoDB. It is warehouse-native, so experiment event data stays in your own warehouse. Targeting attribute values like user IDs and emails are never sent to GrowthBook and stay only in SDK memory. Missing for 10: any documented retention-period settings, deletion or purge workflows (API or UI) for stored data, and data-subject deletion support on GrowthBook Cloud, plus any independent corroboration.
